title: GoFundMe Fundraiser Scraper
description: Scrape GoFundMe fundraiser search results using a GoFundMe search URL or keyword-based search with optional location filtering.

url.title: Search URL
url.description: Optional GoFundMe search URL, e.g. https://www.gofundme.com/s/fundraisers?q=medical. If provided, this input is used first.

keyword.title: Keyword
keyword.description: Keyword to search fundraisers by title or related text (used when URL is not provided).

location.title: Location
location.description: Optional location like city/country (for example: New York, USA) or lat,lng (for example: 40.7128,-74.0060).

results_wanted.title: Results wanted
results_wanted.description: Maximum number of fundraiser records to save.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Optional proxy setup for search requests.
